payload.rationale: Brief sets journey_stage dreaming, primary /magazine and Wedded Advisor secondary after the destination section, which matches services.md for early-stage posts. Primary text avoids 'free': brand-facts.md does not state the magazine is free (only services.md default wording does), and the panel recorded that 'free' beside the magazine was a uhnw turn-off. Secondary subtext uses the brand-facts.md line on the fee agreed in writing, which answers the sceptic and funding_parent worry about how the Advisor is paid and who is accountable, without adding any new business claim. Panel cta_reactions: planner_couple wanted a real wedding with these customs before enquiring, uhnw wanted a private or referral route, funding_parent wanted a phone number and named person. None of these can be added without confirmed business details or licensed real-wedding content, so they are open questions, not copy. Suggested future lead magnet (does not exist on the site): a cultural wedding planning checklist (zaffeh, dabke, henna night, shared feast, venue questions); not placed. Both CTA texts are 6 words or fewer, no exclamation marks, no 'click here', no prices.
